description:
What this server answers: its endpoints, the lanes and whether each is
live, the provenance labels, and the payment presets and splits a profile
can use. Takes no input.

Figures carry a `provenance` (READ, MEASURED, DERIVED, COMPUTED, PROXY, ESTIMATED or GIVEN; defined in the server instructions) and a `basis`; `missing` names figures only the caller holds. Information, not advice.
name: capabilities
title: What TDE serves
